options.text: The finished triangle is the phrase base side.
Drawing the finished triangle is what creates the given sides and the included angle.
Draw $PQ = 8\,\mathrm{cm}$, make $40^{\circ}$ at $P$, mark $PR = 6\,\mathrm{cm}$ on the new arm, and join $R$ to $Q$.
The finished triangle is the printed $40$ alone.

stem:
Pallavi must construct $\triangle PQR$ given $PQ = 8\,\mathrm{cm}$, $PR = 6\,\mathrm{cm}$, and included $\angle P = 40^{\circ}$.

Which construction plan is correct?

teacher.key_rationale: With two sides and the included angle, take PQ as base, build 40° at P, mark PR=6 cm on the new arm, then join R to Q. Naming 'base side', reversing construction into data, or grabbing the printed 40 all miss that plan.
